verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.

segments.text: Praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.text: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.text: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.

segments.text: Praise him with timbrel and dance:
Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.

verses.text: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.

verses.text: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
